stock.description: BOSA Technology Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, delivering specialized mechanical splicing solutions for the reinforced concrete construction sector across Hong Kong. Their core operations involve the precise processing of reinforcing bars, including tasks such as cutting, crimping, and threading, as well as their subsequent connection through the use of couplers. The firm caters to a broad spectrum of clients, including various contractors and subcontractors. Established in 2012, BOSA Technology Holdings Limited has its main corporate offices located in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.
